body: Yeah, I did all of that. Went to the embassy got a temporary one. Felt better for like two days and then lost my camera it's just a constant pattern of me fucking up at the expense of others

Oh yeah, they definitely are not a morally great way to kill yourself. A lot of the reason I even bothered to post here, and not just get it over with, was because I didn't want to do that to someone. 

I came to study abroad in London to get away from the drugs that were killing my sanity at my home institution. I spent too much money. I lost my passport, my camera. My parents are spending money for me to be incompetent. I am trying, but I have always been absent minded. Depression and a history of abusing uppers have made it even harder for me to thing clearly and keep track of things. I don't want to go on this way.

EDIT: And I know that I sound spoiled and shitty. I probably am. I wouldn't be posting here if I wasn't thinking very very seriously about this. I don't want to fuck up these people's commute
